narr: Thunderstorm development across the higher terrain occurred once again on this day, with heavy rainfall and flash flooding the main concerns. Heavy rainfall with flash flooding and even pockets of damaging winds were all observed across the upper Arkansas River Valley.
ev: Heavy rainfall washed out County road 371, from a small drainage which flows across the road. Two cars were stuck in the mud.
lsr: HEAVY RAIN WASHED OUT CO ROAD 371 IN SMALL DRAINAGE WHICH FLOWS ACROSS ROAD. 2 CARS STUCK IN MUD.
